title.en: What is small?
title.zh: 什么叫小？

summary.en: The definition chooses the comparison before any return is calculated.
summary.zh: 比较收益前，先明确哪些公司属于小盘股。

question.en: Does the smallest company mean the same thing across markets?
question.zh: 不同市场的最小公司，是同一种研究对象吗？

conclusion.en: Dollar capitalization and within-market ranks answer different questions. Neither is a universal small-cap definition.
conclusion.zh: 美元市值与市场内排名适用于不同研究问题。小盘股的定义需要结合研究目的确定。

title.en: Start with the economic question
title.zh: 先确定经济问题

paragraphs.en: An investor looking for overlooked businesses may call a company small because analysts rarely cover it. A portfolio researcher needs a rule that another person can repeat: a dollar threshold, a percentile or the smallest fixed number of eligible listings. These rules select different businesses, even on the same day.
paragraphs.zh: 投资者可能因为一家公司少人研究而称它为小公司。组合研究需要别人可以重复的筛选规则。可以设定美元市值门槛或市值百分位，也可以在合格股票中选取市值最小的固定数量。即使在同一天，这些规则也会选出不同企业。

paragraphs.en: A smallest-400 rule fixes the number of holdings but lets its share of the market change as listings expand. A bottom-quintile rule fixes a fraction but lets the number and dollar size change. The share definition, exchange universe and historical eligibility belong in the definition too.
paragraphs.zh: 最小400只固定了持股数量，却会随上市公司增加而改变覆盖比例。最小五分之一固定比例，数量和美元规模则随之变化。股数口径、交易所范围与历史资格也都是定义的一部分。

paragraphs.en: Dollar thresholds are useful when the question concerns a given economic scale. Within-market ranks are useful when the question concerns a company’s position among its local peers. Neither rule automatically gives comparable trading conditions. Currency conversion aligns a unit of account, while eligibility and share definitions still need their own checks.
paragraphs.zh: 研究某个经济规模时，美元门槛比较直接。研究公司在当地股票中的位置时，市场内排名更合适。两种规则都不会自动产生可比交易条件。换汇只对齐计价单位，入选资格和股本定义仍需另查。

paragraphs.en: A fixed-N portfolio also changes its coverage as the listed universe expands. The bottom 400 in a smaller historical universe need not resemble the bottom 400 years later. A historical test should preserve the number of eligible names on each formation date, rather than applying today’s universe backwards.
paragraphs.zh: 固定数量组合的覆盖比例会随上市公司数量变化。较小历史股票池中的末400只，未必像多年后的末400只。历史检验应保存每个形成日的合格股票数量，不能把今天的股票池倒推回去。

title.en: Two lenses on the same evidence
title.zh: 同一证据的两种看法

paragraphs.en: Use the absolute buckets to ask how much daily trading activity accompanies a given dollar size. Switch to within-market quintiles to ask how the smallest local segment differs from larger local companies. A bottom quintile in one market need not fit the same dollar bucket in another.
paragraphs.zh: 绝对市值分组用来观察给定美元规模对应多少日常交易活动。市场内五分组用来比较当地最小一端与较大公司。一个市场的最小五分之一，未必落在另一个市场相同的美元区间。

paragraphs.en: The chart keeps one lagged traded-value measure while changing the grouping rule. That isolates a useful descriptive choice, but it does not harmonize listing rules, share classes or source histories. Common dates remove one obvious mismatch; they do not make the underlying samples identical.
paragraphs.zh: 图表保持滞后成交额指标不变，只切换分组方式。这有助于理解口径差别，但不能统一上市制度、股份类别与来源历史。共同日期消除了一项明显差异，不能让底层样本变成同一个股票池。

paragraphs.en: The absolute and relative panels are separate source projections. Changing the selector does not match the same companies one by one. In particular, a market can have no retained value in a selected group even when other groups are populated. An empty cell must stay missing rather than becoming a zero-dollar observation.
paragraphs.zh: 绝对规模与相对排名来自分别保留的来源投影。切换控件并没有逐只匹配同一批公司。某个市场在选定分组中可能没有保留值，即使其他组有数据。空格应继续显示缺失，不能填成零美元。

paragraphs.en: The latest retained 2026 period does not include the US. Selecting it should make that absence visible. An apparently complete market comparison can otherwise be produced simply by hiding a market whose source stopped earlier.
paragraphs.zh: 保留的2026年区间没有美股数据。选到这段时期时，页面应明确显示这项缺口。若把提前停止覆盖的市场藏起来，一份看似齐全的跨市场比较就可能被错误制造出来。

title.en: Size is a starting hypothesis
title.zh: 规模只是研究起点

paragraphs.en: The literature raises quality and shell-value questions because market capitalization can travel with other characteristics. Our retained low-turnover association is a separate exploratory question. Without matched formation dates, weights and quality controls, a resemblance in direction is not a replication or an explanation.
paragraphs.zh: 文献提出质量和壳价值问题，因为市值常与其他特征同时变化。保留的低换手关联是另一项探索问题。若未对齐形成日、权重与质量控制，方向相似不能算复现，也不能算解释。

title.en: Write down the definition before measuring returns
title.zh: 计算收益前先写清定义

paragraphs.en: Record the size variable and formation clock with the selection rule. Total market capitalization and freely tradable capitalization answer different questions. A classification based on later share counts can move a stock into a different historical group even if the observed price has not changed.
paragraphs.zh: 选股规则要连同规模变量和形成时点保存。总市值与可自由交易部分的市值回答不同问题。若使用后来取得的股数，一只股票可能在价格不变时被重新分到另一个历史组。

paragraphs.en: Keep suspensions, changed identifiers and later exits in the research record. A company that disappears from a modern database is still part of the question if the historical rule would have selected it. Eligibility, a quoted price and an executable order are separate checks.
paragraphs.zh: 停牌、标识变化和后来退出样本的公司都应留在研究记录中。只要历史规则当时会选中，公司后来从现代数据库中消失，也仍属于研究对象。入选资格、能否取得报价和订单能否执行，各需检查。

paragraphs.en: The next useful comparison is therefore a pair of explicitly defined universes on the same dates. Only after those universes are recorded should the study ask whether their returns or trading conditions differ. The chart helps inspect the definition; it does not decide which definition is universally correct.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来有用的比较，是同一日期上两份定义清楚的股票池。保存股票池之后，再问收益或交易条件是否不同。图表可以帮助检查定义，不能替研究决定一种普遍正确的口径。

limitations.en: Japanese historical share counts are incomplete; common dates do not certify point-in-time eligibility.
limitations.zh: 日股历史股数不完整。即使比较日期相同，仍需核实股票在历史时点的入选资格。

nextSteps.en: Freeze size, share and eligibility rules before comparing returns on common support.
nextSteps.zh: 先冻结规模、股数与资格规则，再在共同样本比较收益。

opening.en: A fixed count makes a portfolio easy to describe: take the smallest 400 eligible stocks. The count alone says little about what those companies look like. Their dollar values change over time, and the same count can cover very different fractions of two markets. The definition determines which economic question the portfolio can answer.
opening.zh: 选出合格股票中市值最小的400只，这个组合很容易描述。400这个数量本身，却没有说明这些企业有多小。它们的美元规模会随时间变化，在两个市场中也可能覆盖很不一样的比例。定义会决定这份组合能回答什么问题。

opening.en: The retained liquidity aggregates let us examine this difference directly. The instrument below keeps the trading-activity measure fixed while changing the size grouping. Begin with a common period and inspect the sample counts as well as the bars. A change in the grouping rule can change both the companies selected and the conclusion drawn from them.
opening.zh: 保留的流动性汇总可以直接检查这个区别。下方互动保持成交活跃度指标不变，只改变规模分组。可以先选同一时期，再一起查看柱形与样本数量。换一种分组规则，入选企业和由此得出的判断都可能改变。

title.en: What did the smallest portfolios endure?
title.zh: 最小市值组合经历了什么？

summary.en: Loss depth and time below a prior peak matter independently of a final return.
summary.zh: 评估历史表现时，除了期末收益，还需单独考察损失有多深、恢复需要多久。

question.en: How much could a rule lose, and how long did recovery take?
question.zh: 一条规则曾亏损多少，又等待多久才恢复？

conclusion.en: The retained reconstructions show deep losses and material waiting times. Accounting and eligibility limits block a claim of validated investable alpha.
conclusion.zh: 保留的重建结果显示，组合曾大幅亏损，恢复也需要较长时间。可投资超额收益仍待验证，账户核算和历史入选资格尚未核实完整。

title.en: Read the path before the endpoint
title.zh: 先看过程，再看终点

paragraphs.en: A high ending value does not tell an investor whether they could have held through the path. A drawdown measures the loss from a previous peak. An underwater duration measures the wait until that peak is recovered. A shallow but persistent decline can tie up capital differently from a sharp, quickly recovered fall.
paragraphs.zh: 较高的期末净值不能说明投资者能否熬过中途。回撤衡量相对前高的损失，水下期衡量等到重回前高所需时间。浅但持久的下跌，与猛烈但迅速恢复的下跌，会以不同方式占用资金。

paragraphs.en: The early 2008–2014 summaries report maximum drawdowns from roughly 60% to 69% across the retained 50 to 800-name rules. These are properties of the stated incomplete reconstruction, not estimates of a future loss limit. Wider portfolios did not mechanically eliminate the historical downside in this sample.
paragraphs.zh: 2008至2014年早期汇总中，保留的50至800只股票规则的最大回撤约为60%至69%。这是注明存在缺项的重建结果，不能当作未来损失上限。在这个样本里，扩大持股数量并未机械消除历史下行风险。

paragraphs.en: Drawdown uses the highest earlier NAV as its denominator. A loss from the start of a calendar year uses a different starting value. They can both describe the same day correctly while producing different percentages, so a date and denominator should accompany every quoted loss.
paragraphs.zh: 回撤的分母是此前最高净值，年初以来收益使用另一个起始值。同一天的两个百分比可能都算得正确，却回答不同问题。引用损失时，应一起保留日期和分母。

paragraphs.en: Recovery is asymmetric. A value that falls from 100 to 50 needs a 100% gain to return to 100. This arithmetic does not forecast a rebound; it explains why a positive subsequent return can coexist with an account that remains below its earlier high.
paragraphs.zh: 恢复并不对称。一个数值从100跌到50，需要上涨100%才能回到100。这只是算术关系，没有预测反弹。它解释了为什么后续收益为正，账户仍可能低于以前的高点。

title.en: Keep the two samples apart
title.zh: 把两段样本分开

paragraphs.en: The count selector describes early risk summaries. The actual NAV curve comes from a separate published 400-name reconstruction beginning in 2015. We have not filled missing curves from summary statistics, joined the two periods or inferred unobserved daily returns. Changing count therefore changes the early summary, not the later curve.
paragraphs.zh: 数量切换展示早期风险汇总。实际净值曲线来自另一份2015年开始的400只公开重建。我们没有根据汇总补造曲线、拼接区间或推断未观察的日收益。因此切换股票数改变早期汇总，不改变后期曲线。

paragraphs.en: In the early source, the longest underwater duration counts completed episodes only. Every count also has one episode still underwater at the sample end. That is right censoring: the eventual recovery is unknown, so the completed maximum cannot be read as a guaranteed waiting-time bound.
paragraphs.zh: 早期来源的最长水下期只统计已恢复区间。每组数量另有一个截至样本末仍未恢复的区间。这类情况称为右删失，最终恢复时间仍未知。因此，已恢复区间中的最长时间只能描述已完成的恢复过程，未来等待可能更久。

paragraphs.en: The early chart shows retained summary values rather than reconstructed daily paths. The 400-name early summary includes a 506-observation recovery interval; this is not 506 calendar days. A larger count does not automatically remove the common market exposure that can affect many holdings together.
paragraphs.zh: 早期图展示保留的汇总值，没有补造逐日路径。早期400只汇总中有506个观测间隔的恢复期，这不等于506个日历日。扩大持仓数量，也不会自动消除许多股票共同承受的市场敞口。

paragraphs.en: For the later series, the timeline can be narrowed to a chosen start and end. The return histogram changes the holding interval, while the monthly calendar records actual retained observations. A monthly closing gain can hide a deeper decline earlier in that same month.
paragraphs.zh: 后段序列可以在时间线上选起点和终点。收益分布允许改变持有间隔，月度日历使用实际保留的观测。一个月收盘上涨，仍可能遮住该月早些时候更深的下跌。

title.en: An audit can change the question
title.zh: 审计会改变问题

paragraphs.en: Historical eligibility, missing prices, suspensions and corporate actions can change both selected holdings and the account path. Matching a summary number does not recover the original runtime. Completed provider queries do not prove that all entitlements have been settled correctly. MC-C05 and MC-C06 retain those distinctions.
paragraphs.zh: 历史资格、缺失价格、停牌和公司行动可能同时改变选股与账户路径。汇总数接近不能找回原运行，供应商请求完成也不能证明所有权益已经正确结算。MC-C05与MC-C06保留了这些区别。

paragraphs.en: The next useful step is to reconcile raw shares and cash under fixed rules, then revisit the same historical episodes. A new calm month would add an observation; it would not erase a past loss or repair an unresolved ledger.
paragraphs.zh: 下一步要在固定规则下核对真实股份与现金，再检查同一批历史案例。即使未来新增月份的表现平稳，过去的损失和待核对的账本问题仍需单独处理。

title.en: Follow the curve back to its account
title.zh: 沿着净值追到账户

paragraphs.en: The report preserves more than one reconstruction and more than one audit interval. Missing-price counts need their sample denominator, and the later bounded share-account review does not certify the full 400-stock series. Read the account chapter before turning this curve into an execution claim.
paragraphs.zh: 旧报告保留多套重建和多个审计区间。缺价次数需要连同样本分母阅读，后来有限区间股份账户通过核验，也没有认证完整400只序列。把曲线用于执行判断前，可以先读账户章节。

title.en: Which additional claim needs another test?
title.zh: 再往前下判断，需要补什么检验

paragraphs.en: The curve describes a rule reconstruction. An excess-return claim additionally needs a benchmark with matched dates, costs and risk treatment. Comparing it with a convenient large-cap index after inspecting the result would leave the benchmark choice entangled with the finding.
paragraphs.zh: 这条曲线描述一项规则重建。要进一步判断超额收益，还需要日期、成本和风险处理匹配的基准。看过结果后再挑一个方便的大盘指数，基准选择就可能与结论缠在一起。

paragraphs.en: An investability claim adds a different requirement. Every selected stock must connect to an inventory, cash and event record, including days when an order cannot be completed. A missing quote should not quietly remove the position or redistribute its weight among the survivors.
paragraphs.zh: 可投资性又增加了一项要求。每只入选股票都要接到库存、现金与事件记录，包括订单无法完成的日期。缺失报价不应悄悄删掉持仓，也不应把权重分配给剩下的股票。

paragraphs.en: These checks can change the accepted return without changing the historical price observations. The account chapter follows a bounded example of that process. The present path remains useful as a risk description while those stronger claims are tested.
paragraphs.zh: 这些核查可能改变最终接受的收益，却不需要改变历史价格观测。账户章节记录了一段有限区间的核验过程。在更强判断接受检验时，这条路径仍可以用于描述历史风险。

limitations.en: Early historical ST and suspension coverage is incomplete; the 400-name later NAV has no transaction-cost or capacity model.
limitations.zh: 早期历史ST与停牌覆盖不完整。后期400只净值没有成本或容量模型。

nextSteps.en: Reconcile raw-share and cash accounting before using reconstructed performance for an implementation decision.
nextSteps.zh: 在用重建表现作实施决策前，先核对真实股份与现金账本。

opening.en: A high ending NAV compresses years of very different experiences into one number. The retained microcap reconstruction makes those experiences visible. It contains sharp falls and long periods below a previous peak, so the first task is to describe the path before attributing its return to a premium.
opening.zh: 很高的期末净值，会把多年中很不一样的经历压成一个数字。保留的微盘重建让这些过程重新可见。曲线里有急跌，也有长时间低于此前高点的阶段，因此先要描述路径，再讨论收益能否归于某种溢价。

opening.en: This investigation keeps two source periods separate. Early risk summaries compare several portfolio sizes, while the later interactive path contains only the published 400-name series. The difference is visible in the figures and remains part of every conclusion drawn below.
opening.zh: 本篇把两段来源分开。早期风险汇总可以比较多种持仓数量，后面的互动路径则只有已发布的400只序列。图中会显示这个区别，下面的判断也都保留这项范围限制。

title.en: Can small stocks be traded?
title.zh: 小股票是否容易交易？

summary.en: Trading activity is a useful first screen; a sellable portfolio requires more evidence.
summary.zh: 成交活跃度是有用的初筛，但能卖出的组合需要更多证据。

question.en: What does a traded-value comparison establish about getting in and out?
question.zh: 成交额比较能告诉我们多少买入和退出能力？

conclusion.en: Reviewed aggregates describe activity across selected markets and periods. They do not establish spreads, fills, market impact or deployable capital.
conclusion.zh: 已审查汇总描述了特定市场和区间的成交活跃度。价差、实际成交和市场冲击仍需另行测量，可投入的资金规模也尚待验证。

title.en: Start with the right unit
title.zh: 先看清单位

paragraphs.en: The displayed measure starts with each security’s mean daily traded value over 20 prior sessions, lagged by a session and converted into USD. The bucket median describes the middle observation. It is not the dollar amount a new investor can immediately buy or sell at the last price.
paragraphs.zh: 展示指标先计算每只证券此前20个交易日的日均成交额，再滞后一个交易日并换算美元。分组中位数表示样本中间位置的成交额。新增投资者能按最新价立即买卖多少，仍需实际执行证据。

paragraphs.en: For a historical period, the sample pools security-days. A company observed many days can appear many times; a unique-stock count answers a different question. Empty groups remain empty, and an observed zero is not interchangeable with a missing session.
paragraphs.zh: 历史区间汇集证券日。同一家公司在多个日期会出现多次，独立股票数回答另一问题。空分组仍为空，实际观测到的零成交也不能与缺失交易日混为一谈。

paragraphs.en: The displayed value is an activity statistic for a retained group. It is not the dollars available at the best bid when our sell order arrives. Daily volume can be spread unevenly across the session, and the price at which it traded need not remain available.
paragraphs.zh: 展示值统计各分组的成交活跃度。卖单到达时能在买一档取得多少金额，需要当时的报价与挂单量。全天成交可能在时段之间分布不均，已经成交的价格也未必继续可用。

paragraphs.en: Order size must be stated in the same unit as its constraint. A share-volume limit and a notional participation limit differ when prices move. The retained research previously corrected traded-value units; reproducing a capacity estimate requires carrying those units through the entire calculation.
paragraphs.zh: 订单规模与约束要使用一致单位。价格变化时，按股数限制成交量与按金额限制参与率并不相同。已有研究曾修正成交额单位，复现容量估计时，需要把单位检查贯穿整个计算。

title.en: Dates and market names are not coverage guarantees
title.zh: 日期与市场名不等于覆盖保证

paragraphs.en: The available common periods include a shared 2025 snapshot and historical windows. The 2026 common period includes Hong Kong, China equities, China A-shares and Japan, ending in April; it does not contain US observations. The source retains different latest snapshots by market, which we do not combine into a same-day comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 可用共同区间包括2025年的同日快照及若干历史窗口。2026年共同区间包括中国香港港股、中国 A 股与日股，止于四月，不含美股观测。来源还保留各市场日期不同的最新快照，本页未把它们拼成同日比较。

paragraphs.en: Mainland coverage is Shanghai and Shenzhen, not every Chinese exchange. Japanese historical shares are incomplete and have not been certified against historical revisions. Even on common dates, listing coverage and valuation definitions differ. Use the chart to frame questions, not rank whole national markets as permanently liquid or illiquid.
paragraphs.zh: 内地样本仅覆盖沪深交易所。日股历史股数不完整，数据在历史修订前是否可得也尚未核实。即使日期相同，上市范围和估值定义仍有差别。图表适合帮助提出问题，不宜据此给整个国家市场贴上永久流动或不流动的标签。

paragraphs.en: Two markets can share calendar endpoints while using different trading days or security definitions. The instrument reports retained source dates and sample sizes; it does not certify a common historical universe. A comparison should keep the source-specific missing groups visible.
paragraphs.zh: 两个市场即使共享日历端点，也可能使用不同交易日和证券定义。互动图报告保留的来源日期及样本数量，没有认证共同历史股票池。比较时应保留各来源缺失的组。

paragraphs.en: A mean or median over surviving observations can also conceal the difficult stocks that disappeared from coverage. The next audit must ask whether those absences reflect eligibility, inactive listings or incomplete data, rather than assuming they were cheap or easy to trade.
paragraphs.zh: 仅对保留下来的观测取均值或中位数，也可能遮住已退出覆盖的困难股票。下一步审计需要区分资格、失效上市与数据不完整，不能假定这些缺失股票交易便宜或容易。

title.en: Move from a budget to a fill
title.zh: 从预算走向成交

paragraphs.en: A participation budget assumes an investor takes some fraction of market activity. It cannot establish that counterparties were available at an acceptable price or that a queued order filled. Spread, displayed depth, queue position, order policy and settlement each add constraints. A static depth calculation and a US NBBO spread are different measurements.
paragraphs.zh: 参与率预算假定投资者使用市场成交的一部分，不能证明可接受价格上存在对手方，也不能证明排队订单成交。价差、展示深度、排队位置、订单规则和结算都会加上约束。静态深度成本与美股NBBO价差也是不同指标。

paragraphs.en: The full-text readings of Amihud and Novy-Marx–Velikov now distinguish a return/volume proxy, fitted effective spreads and holding buffers. Their US results do not supply local cost constants. The quality-control paper remains an author-summary lead. No BMLL security-level observations are published.
paragraphs.zh: 本次全文阅读区分了Amihud的收益成交额代理、Novy-Marx与Velikov的有效价差估计及持有缓冲。美股结果不能提供本地成本常数。质量控制论文仍停留在作者摘要层面。本站不发布BMLL逐证券观测。

title.en: Keep the order clock and remainder
title.zh: 保留下单时钟与剩余数量

paragraphs.en: A quote-based model first fixes a decision time and then an arrival time. Cost relative to the decision midpoint combines the spread paid at arrival with intervening price movement. A stale quote can make both the apparent price and quantity misleading, so quote age belongs beside the estimate.
paragraphs.zh: 报价模型先固定决策时刻，再固定到达时刻。相对决策中间价的成本，同时包含到达时跨过的价差和等待期间价格变化。陈旧报价可能同时误导价格与数量判断，报价年龄应放在估计旁边。

paragraphs.en: For an order larger than the displayed top level, retain the remainder. A low cost on the small modeled part does not price the rest of the order. Assuming that a later copy of the same quote is fresh liquidity can repeatedly spend a quantity that was only displayed once.
paragraphs.zh: 订单超过最优档显示数量时，应保留余量。已模拟的小部分成本很低，并没有给剩下的订单定价。若把后来重复出现的相同报价都当作新流动性，就可能反复使用只展示过一次的数量。

paragraphs.en: The event-level chapter makes these assumptions explicit. Its short-window scenarios and the cross-market activity chart are complementary descriptions with different resolutions. Neither alone establishes a fund size that can reliably enter and exit the strategy.
paragraphs.zh: 事件级章节会明确这些假设。短窗口情景与跨市场活跃度图属于不同分辨率的互补描述，单独任何一项，都没有确定策略可以可靠进出的资金规模。

limitations.en: Historical point-in-time eligibility and executable capacity are not certified.
limitations.zh: 尚未认证历史时点资格与可执行容量。

nextSteps.en: Specify capital, order rules and account treatment, then compare calibrated fills on matched dates.
nextSteps.zh: 固定资金、订单规则与账户处理，再在对齐日期比较经过校准的成交。

opening.en: Buying a small stock and selling a large position in it are different demands on the market. Average daily traded value gives a useful first view, but the order arrives at a particular time and meets the quotes then available. This investigation moves from that coarse activity measure to the quantities an execution study must retain.
opening.zh: 买入一只小股票，与卖出它的一笔大持仓，对市场提出的要求不同。日均成交额可以提供第一层观察，订单却会在具体时刻到达，面对当时的报价。本篇从较粗的成交活跃度，走到执行研究需要保留的数量。

opening.en: Start with the cross-market instrument below. The same dollar-size group can contain very different traded-value distributions across markets. The dates and group counts matter as much as the level of the bars, especially where coverage is absent.
opening.zh: 可以先看下方跨市场互动。同一个美元规模组，在不同市场中可能对应很不一样的成交额分布。日期和分组数量与柱形高低同样重要，尤其要看哪些地方缺少覆盖。

title.en: What do the full papers actually test?
title.zh: 全文究竟检验了什么？

summary.en: Three reviewed papers connect universe exclusions, illiquidity measurement and buffers to specific local tests.
summary.zh: 把三篇已读论文的股票池剔除、非流动性指标和缓冲规则，接到具体的本地检验。

question.en: Which literature mechanisms can our retained evidence test?
question.zh: 保留的证据能检验哪些文献机制？

conclusion.en: Shell exclusions, illiquidity proxies and trading buffers require different data. Our present aggregates cannot identify these mechanisms.
conclusion.zh: 排除壳股、非流动性代理与持有缓冲各需不同数据。现有汇总无法识别这些机制。

title.en: Read the actual edition
title.zh: 先辨认实际版本

paragraphs.en: Three papers have now been read in full. The literature records retain PDF hashes and page references. The China paper is the December 11, 2018 Wharton forthcoming manuscript; the cost study is the December 2014 NBER working paper. Results are attributed to those editions. Banz and the quality-control paper remain leads.
paragraphs.zh: 本次已完整阅读三篇论文，文献记录保留PDF哈希与页码。中国研究采用2018年12月11日Wharton待刊稿，成本研究采用2014年12月NBER工作论文。结论均对应实际阅读版本。Banz与质量控制论文仍是待深入阅读的线索。

title.en: China size evidence begins with a universe choice
title.zh: 中国规模证据先从股票池选择开始

paragraphs.en: The reviewed China manuscript excludes the smallest 30% by lagged size before constructing its factors. Its 2000–2016 setting therefore differs from a portfolio devoted to that tail. The exclusion can motivate a matched sensitivity test, but the paper’s shell-value interpretation cannot simply be assigned to every later microcap return. The literature record retains the construction references on pages 4–5, 12 and 25–28.
paragraphs.zh: 所读中国研究先按滞后市值排除最小30%，再构造因子。它的2000至2016年设定，与专门投资最小一端的组合不同。排除规则可以启发同口径敏感性检验，但论文的壳价值解释不能直接赋予之后所有微盘收益。文献记录保留了第4至5、12、25至28页的构造依据。

paragraphs.en: Our exclusion panel removes fractions of eligible stock counts and rebuilds signals. A positive result after exclusion would describe that reconstructed candidate. Establishing the underlying mechanism would additionally require dated corporate events and a design that distinguishes shell exposure from correlated characteristics.
paragraphs.zh: 本站剔除面板移除一定比例的合格股票只数，再重算信号。剔除后收益为正，只能描述相应重建候选。要进一步识别机制，还需要带日期的公司事件，以及能区分壳敞口和相关特征的研究设计。

title.en: Trading activity and price sensitivity measure different things
title.zh: 成交活跃度与价格敏感性各测什么

paragraphs.en: Amihud’s ILLIQ combines absolute daily returns with dollar trading value. A stock can trade a small amount without moving much, or move sharply on similar turnover. Its construction therefore contains information absent from a simple average traded-value ranking. The reviewed measurement and sample rules are recorded on pages 34–41.
paragraphs.zh: Amihud 的 ILLIQ 把每日绝对收益与美元成交额放在一起。股票可能成交很少但价格变化不大，也可能在相近成交额下大幅变动。这个构造包含平均成交额排名没有直接表达的信息。所读版本第34至41页记录了指标和样本规则。

paragraphs.en: A test on our stocks needs security-level daily returns, currency-consistent traded values and enough past observations. Zero volume, suspensions and missing prices require explicit handling. The archived conditional-spread panel is useful for comparison, while reproducing the paper still requires its full sample and regression contract.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的股票上检验，需要逐证券日收益、币种一致的成交额和足够的过去观测。零成交、停牌与缺失价格都要明确处理。归档条件收益差面板可用于对照，复现论文仍须匹配完整样本和回归口径。

title.en: A holding buffer changes the portfolio as well as its trades
title.zh: 持有缓冲同时改变组合与交易

paragraphs.en: The reviewed cost paper separates entry and exit ranks to reduce trading near a boundary. Its pages 29–36 and 42–44 report the buffer experiments. A stock kept by a buffer remains exposed to its subsequent return, so cost savings and portfolio composition move together.
paragraphs.zh: 所读成本论文把买入与退出排名分开，减少边界附近的交易，第29至36、42至44页记录了缓冲实验。被缓冲保留的股票仍会贡献后续收益，因此费用节省和组合构成会同时变化。

paragraphs.en: Our archived paired configurations show lower turnover in every buffered pair, with higher annual returns in only some pairs. This is a concrete reason to inspect holdings, fees and net returns together. A target-membership comparison is an early diagnostic; a raw-share cash account is needed before attaching an execution claim.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的归档配对配置中，缓冲全部降低换手，只有部分配置提高年化收益。这支持把持仓、费用和净收益放在一起检查。目标成员比较属于前期诊断，执行判断还需要原始股份现金账户。

title.en: Turn a comparison into a test
title.zh: 让对照变成检验

paragraphs.en: Our next tests must freeze input contracts first: historical eligibility and total shares for a tail exclusion; daily security returns and traded values for ILLIQ; holdings transitions and an order-cost policy for buffers. These are independent research plans, not completed replications. The literature cards give concise method and result notes.
paragraphs.zh: 后续检验要先固定输入口径。排除最小市值股票需要历史资格和总股数，计算ILLIQ则需要逐证券日收益与成交额。持有缓冲的检验还须记录持仓变动，并确定订单成本规则。这些独立研究计划尚未完成复现。文献卡片提供简要方法与结果笔记。

paragraphs.en: A useful replication starts with a mapping from the paper’s quantities to our fields. If the paper uses a long-short factor, the comparison should retain both legs. If it requires a lagged characteristic, the field’s availability date must be checked rather than inferred from the period it describes.
paragraphs.zh: 有用的复现应先把论文中的量映射到我们的字段。论文使用多空因子时，对照要保留两条腿。要求滞后特征时，应核对字段何时可获取，不能根据它描述的报告期推定可用时间。

paragraphs.en: A result that does not reproduce is part of the record. The window study’s archived and rerun values illustrate why source identity and the minimum-observation rule matter. Changing a threshold after seeing the discrepancy creates a sensitivity result; it does not recover the original run by itself.
paragraphs.zh: 没有复现的结果也属于研究记录。窗口研究中的原值和复算值，说明来源身份与最低观测规则为什么重要。看到差距后改变门槛，得到的是一项敏感性结果，单靠这一步还没有恢复原始运行。

limitations.en: A full reading upgrades reading status, not the stage of an empirical claim.
limitations.zh: 全文阅读提升阅读状态，不提升实证结论阶段。

nextSteps.en: Run matched protocols only after their required historical inputs are available.
nextSteps.zh: 取得所需历史输入后，再运行匹配方案。

opening.en: A paper can change the research question before it changes a trading rule. The three editions read here point to different problems: the historical universe used to construct size factors, the measurement of illiquidity, and the effect of holding buffers on costs. Keeping those questions separate makes the comparison with our own evidence more useful.
opening.zh: 论文可以先改变研究问题，再影响交易规则。这里读过的三个版本分别指向不同问题，涉及规模因子的历史股票池、非流动性的度量，以及持有缓冲怎样影响成本。把问题分清，才更容易与我们的证据对照。

opening.en: The notes below retain the actual editions and page references. Their conclusions guide specific tests rather than becoming labels attached to any attractive small-cap curve. The inline comparison shows how a control changes an archived spread while preserving its uncertainty.
opening.zh: 下文保留实际版本和页码。论文结论用于指导具体检验，不能直接贴到一条表现吸引人的小盘曲线上。文中互动展示控制后归档收益差怎样改变，并保留相应不确定性。

title.en: Which losses disappear in a yearly return?
title.zh: 年度收益掩盖了哪些损失？

summary.en: An independent calculation exposes holding-window losses, recovery waits and endpoint censoring.
summary.zh: 我们独立计算了各持有窗口的损失和恢复时间，并保留样本结束时尚未恢复的区间。

question.en: How does changing the holding window change the historical risk description?
question.zh: 持有窗口改变后，历史风险如何变化？

conclusion.en: The frozen NAV spent 84.7% of observations below its running peak. A positive calendar year can contain a large, long-lived loss.
conclusion.zh: 冻结净值有84.7%的观测低于此前峰值。盈利的自然年也可能包含深且持久的损失。

title.en: One frozen series, a new calculation
title.zh: 同一冻结序列，新增计算

paragraphs.en: We independently derive 2,837 consecutive ratios from 2,838 NAV levels dated January 5, 2015 to September 4, 2026. No first-day return is invented. The script checks positive finite levels and strictly increasing dates. Observation steps are not calendar days; a dated NAV does not certify a filled trade.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从2015年1月5日至2026年9月4日的2838个净值，独立计算2837个相邻比值，不补造首日收益。脚本检查净值为有限正数、日期严格递增。观测间隔不等于自然日，带日期的净值也不能证明真实成交。

paragraphs.en: A running high-water mark carries information across calendar years. Resetting it every January would erase unfinished losses from the previous year. The diagnostics instead preserve earlier peaks and keep incomplete recoveries separate from completed episodes.
paragraphs.zh: 历史高点会跨过年份边界。如果每年1月重置，就会抹掉上一年尚未恢复的损失。这里的诊断保留此前高点，也把未完成恢复与已经结束的事件分开。

paragraphs.en: An underwater share counts observations, not the number of independent crises. Several hundred days from one long episode can dominate that fraction. The episode duration and the maximum loss therefore need to be read alongside the aggregate share.
paragraphs.zh: 水下比例统计观测次数，没有统计相互独立的危机数量。一段很长的事件，可能给这个比例贡献数百个日期。因此，事件持续时间和最深损失需要与汇总比例一起阅读。

title.en: A profitable year can contain a crisis
title.zh: 年度盈利也可能经历危机

paragraphs.en: The 2024 last-observation return is +31.71%, but the January 3 peak fell 37.94% by February 6 and recovered only on September 30, 179 observation steps later. In 2015 the largest peak-to-trough loss was 51.27%, from June 11 to July 7; recovery occurred on November 19, 107 steps after the peak.
paragraphs.zh: 2024年末相对上年末增长31.71%，但1月3日高点至2月6日下跌37.94%，直到9月30日才恢复，距高点179个观测间隔。2015年最大峰谷损失为51.27%，发生在6月11日至7月7日，11月19日恢复，距高点107个间隔。

paragraphs.en: The 2024 example makes the reporting boundary concrete. The series ends that year above its starting level, while the path contains a deep early decline and a much later recovery. A year-end comparison and a peak-to-trough comparison use different denominators and can both be accurate.
paragraphs.zh: 2024年的例子让报告边界变得具体。序列在年末高于年初，期间却有年初深跌和更晚的恢复。年末比较与高点到谷底的比较使用不同分母，可以同时算得准确。

paragraphs.en: A monthly closing gain has the same limitation. The return from one month-end to the next does not describe the largest intramonth decline. The separate 2024 investigation follows the actual retained dates rather than treating the month’s sign as its whole experience.
paragraphs.zh: 月末收益也有相同限制。从一个月末到下一个月末的变化，没有描述月内最大下跌。2024年调查沿着实际保留日期展开，不会只用整月的正负号概括经历。

title.en: Holding windows are overlapping historical observations
title.zh: 持有窗口是重叠的历史观察

paragraphs.en: Among 2,817 overlapping 21-step windows, 36.17% lost money and the worst lost 45.40%. Among 2,586 overlapping 252-step windows, 7.54% lost money and the worst lost 29.96%. These are empirical frequencies along one reconstructed path, not independent trials or probabilities for a new investor.
paragraphs.zh: 2817个重叠的21间隔窗口中，36.17%亏损，最差亏45.40%。2586个252间隔窗口中，7.54%亏损，最差亏29.96%。这些频率仅描述一条重建净值路径。窗口彼此重叠，观测相互依赖，无法据此估计新投资者未来的亏损概率。

paragraphs.en: Adjacent starting points share most of their price observations. Their outcomes are therefore highly dependent. A negative fraction over these overlapping windows is an empirical frequency within this path, not a confidence level or an out-of-sample forecast.
paragraphs.zh: 相邻起点会共享大部分价格观测，结果之间存在很强的关联。重叠窗口的负收益比例只统计这条历史路径。估计置信区间或预测样本外亏损，需要另外设计检验。

paragraphs.en: Changing the holding length changes the set of usable starts. Longer windows leave fewer completed outcomes near the end of the sample. Compare both the loss measure and its observation count before deciding that one horizon looks safer.
paragraphs.zh: 改变持有长度，也会改变可用起点集合。窗口越长，样本末尾能够完成的结果越少。判断某个期限看起来更安全前，需要一起比较损失指标和观测数量。

title.en: Keep unfinished recoveries visible
title.zh: 保留尚未完成的恢复

paragraphs.en: At the final observation, the February 24, 2026 peak remained unrecovered after 133 steps; its trough on July 23 was 29.33% below the peak. The eventual recovery time is unknown. Implied daily extremes of −14.82% and +15.68% are properties of the supplied NAV, requiring account and universe reconciliation before any implementation claim.
paragraphs.zh: 期末时，2026年2月24日高点已过133个间隔仍未恢复，7月23日谷底较高点低29.33%。最终恢复时间未知。净值隐含的单日极值为−14.82%与15.68%，属于来源路径的特征。讨论实施前仍需核对账户与股票池。

title.en: A recovery date does not finish the investment account
title.zh: 恢复日期还没有结清投资账户

paragraphs.en: Returning to a previous NAV high does not repay financing charges or compensate for the time capital was unavailable elsewhere. Those quantities require their own cash and benchmark assumptions. The present calculations deliberately retain the observed NAV denominator.
paragraphs.zh: 净值回到前高，不会自动偿还融资费用，也没有补偿这段资金无法用于其他机会的时间。计算这些量，还需要单独的现金和基准假设。当前计算继续使用观测到的净值分母。

paragraphs.en: A buyer also needs an exit rule that could have been specified before the trough was known. Choosing the best historical exit after viewing the curve would answer a different question. The next step is to join dated decisions to positions and unfinished orders, then measure the resulting account.
paragraphs.zh: 买入者还需要一条在知道谷底之前就能规定的退出规则。看过曲线后挑最好的历史退出点，回答的是另一个问题。下一步应把带日期的决策接到持仓和未完成订单，再测量对应账户。

limitations.en: No transaction costs, risk-free series, benchmark, holdings or security-level accounting were added. Diagnostic return frequencies inherit all source reconstruction limitations.
limitations.zh: 本次未补充交易成本、无风险利率、基准、持仓或逐证券核算。诊断频率继承来源重建的全部限制。

nextSteps.en: Reconcile the dated extremes to raw-share and cash ledgers, then rerun the same diagnostics on a certified account path.
nextSteps.zh: 把极端日期与真实股份和现金账本对齐，再在通过核查的账户路径上重算。

opening.en: A calendar year supplies a convenient reporting boundary. Investors can enter in any month, and the capital committed on that date has its own path. The frozen NAV lets us examine that mismatch without inventing a new strategy or a second price history.
opening.zh: 自然年是方便的报告边界，投资者却可能在任何月份进入。那一天投入的资金，会经历自己的路径。冻结净值可以用来检查这个错位，无须另造策略或补一段价格历史。

opening.en: In the retained series, 84.7% of observations lie below a previous peak. This is a description of the whole path, not the probability that a future buyer loses money. The rolling-window instrument below asks a narrower question: what happened after each retained historical starting point over a specified number of observations?
opening.zh: 保留序列中，84.7%的观测低于此前峰值。这个比例统计整段历史路径，未来买入者的亏损概率仍待估计。下方滚动窗口互动问的是更具体的问题，从每个保留的历史起点出发，经过指定数量观测后发生了什么。

title.en: The 2024 microcap drawdown and recovery
title.zh: 2024年微盘急跌与恢复

summary.en: The retained 400-stock reconstruction lost 37.94% from its January peak and first regained it in September. Policy dates provide context; the mechanism remains untested.
summary.zh: 保留的400只股票重建净值从1月高点下跌37.94%，直到9月才重回前高。同期政策提供事件背景，急跌机制仍待检验。

question.en: How did the early-2024 loss unfold, and what can the available evidence establish about its causes?
question.zh: 2024年初的损失如何形成，现有证据能解释哪些原因？

conclusion.en: A positive full-year return coexisted with a 37.94% peak-to-trough loss and 179 observation steps to recovery. The single reconstructed path cannot identify forced deleveraging, redemptions or ETF transmission.
conclusion.zh: 全年收益为正的同时，年内曾从高点下跌37.94%，经历179个观测间隔才恢复。单条重建净值无法识别被动去杠杆、赎回或ETF交易的影响。

title.en: Define the sample before interpreting the crash
title.zh: 先明确这次急跌对应的样本

paragraphs.en: The 400-stock reconstruction shows a sharp loss early in 2024. We recomputed its dated NAV ratios and checked the original CSRC announcements alongside the path. The 242 observations in 2024 describe this retained rule reconstruction, rather than an exchange-published microcap index or an investor account. Its constituents and daily_return fields are empty, so adjacent NAV ratios are the available return measure.
paragraphs.zh: 400只股票重建净值在2024年初出现急跌。我们重新计算了带日期净值的比值，并核对同期证监会原始公告。2024年的242个观测只描述这项保留规则的重建结果。交易所发布的微盘指数和投资者账户各有自己的口径，需要另行核对。原文件的constituents与daily_return字段为空，因此这里用相邻净值比值计算收益。

paragraphs.en: This sample establishes the depth and duration of the recorded loss. It contains no stock-level orders, holdings transitions, margin positions or fund subscriptions and redemptions. Historical eligibility, corporate-action accounting and execution costs remain limitations of the source reconstruction.
paragraphs.zh: 这个样本可以量出记录中的损失深度和持续时间。文件没有逐股订单、持仓变动及融资仓位，也没有基金申购赎回数据。历史入选资格、公司行动核算和交易成本仍受原重建的限制。

title.en: A fast decline and a much longer recovery
title.zh: 急跌之后，恢复用了更长时间

paragraphs.en: The NAV peaked on 3 January 2024 and reached its episode trough on 6 February, falling 37.9416% across 24 observation steps. It first regained the January peak on 30 September, 179 steps after the peak. Steps count adjacent retained observations, not calendar days. The trough-to-recovery return is measured from a different denominator than the preceding loss.
paragraphs.zh: 净值在2024年1月3日达到高点，到2月6日跌至这一轮回撤的谷底，24个观测间隔内下跌37.9416%。9月30日才首次重回1月高点，距高点179个观测间隔。间隔按保留观测之间的步数计算，自然日需另行统计。谷底之后的涨幅以谷底净值为分母，与此前跌幅的分母不同。

paragraphs.en: The next two recorded returns were +6.07% on 7 February and +5.31% on 8 February. Those rebounds left the earlier peak unrecovered. The interactive path lets readers inspect the daily series and change the interval; the February trough is selected retrospectively after observing the full episode.
paragraphs.zh: 随后两个观测日出现反弹，2月7日上涨6.07%，2月8日上涨5.31%，净值仍低于此前高点。互动图可以逐日查看这一过程，也可以改变观察区间。2月谷底是在看完整段历史后确定的日期，事前能否识别仍待检验。

title.en: Monthly endpoints describe different parts of the loss
title.zh: 月末收益与区间损失需要一起看

paragraphs.en: January returned −25.15%, measured from 29 December 2023 to 31 January 2024. February returned +7.60% from 31 January to 29 February, even though the episode trough occurred within that month. March added +2.25%. A positive February endpoint therefore leaves the early-February drawdown and the continued wait for recovery visible only in the daily path.
paragraphs.zh: 1月收益为−25.15%，计算起点是2023年12月29日，终点是2024年1月31日。2月收益为+7.60%，对应1月31日至2月29日，月内仍经历了这一轮回撤的谷底。3月再上涨2.25%。只看2月月末收益，会漏掉月初下跌的深度，以及此后仍需等待恢复的时间。

paragraphs.en: September returned +49.58% from 30 August to 30 September. The full year returned +31.71% from 29 December 2023 to 31 December 2024. These month-end and year-end ratios use the same frozen NAV; no missing daily values, intraday extremes or executable trades have been inferred. Reaching the earlier NAV peak also excludes financing costs and the opportunity cost of waiting.
paragraphs.zh: 9月收益为+49.58%，对应8月30日至9月30日。全年从2023年12月29日至2024年12月31日上涨31.71%。这些月末和年末比值均来自同一份冻结净值，计算未补入缺失日值，也未推断盘中极值或实际成交。净值恢复至前高的计算也没有扣除融资成本和等待期间的机会成本。

title.en: Dated policy records around the trough
title.zh: 谷底附近可以核实的政策日期

paragraphs.en: On 28 January, the CSRC announced a suspension of restricted-share lending effective 29 January. The same release set 18 March as the start date for making securities under market-based agreed securities refinancing available the following day instead of immediately. The announcement and the two implementation dates need to stay separate when constructing an event window.
paragraphs.zh: 证监会在1月28日公告，限售股出借自1月29日起全面暂停。同一公告还规定，转融券市场化约定申报由实时可用调整为次日可用，这项措施自3月18日起实施。研究事件窗口时，要分别记录公告日和两项措施的实施日。

paragraphs.en: On 6 February, the CSRC announced a cap on new securities-refinancing scale at the existing balance, with outstanding positions to be gradually closed. In a separate same-day response, it supported Central Huijin increasing ETF purchases and stated that it would facilitate those operations. These are documented regulatory statements. The ETF response supplies no stock-level purchase allocation or executed order trail for this 400-stock sample.
paragraphs.zh: 证监会在2月6日宣布，以现有转融券余额为上限暂停新增证券公司转融券规模，存量逐步了结。同日另一份答记者问支持中央汇金扩大ETF增持，并表示将为其入市操作提供便利。这些公告可以核实监管表态及其日期。ETF公告没有披露本研究400只股票样本对应的逐股买入分配或实际订单记录。

paragraphs.en: The reconstruction trough falls on 6 February, the same date as these two statements. Daily NAV and publication dates do not reveal within-day sequencing or a counterfactual price path. The chronology therefore cannot quantify a policy effect or establish that the policy caused the subsequent rebound.
paragraphs.zh: 重建净值的谷底恰好落在2月6日，与这两份公告同日。日度净值和发布日期无法确定日内先后顺序，也无法给出没有政策时的价格路径。因此，这份时间线尚不能量化政策效果，反弹成因仍待检验。

title.en: The mechanisms require different observations
title.zh: 解释急跌还缺哪些观测

paragraphs.en: Forced deleveraging is a hypothesis to test with financing exposures, margin thresholds and dated forced-sale records. Redemption pressure requires fund flows and the holdings actually sold. ETF transmission requires creations and redemptions, basket composition and stock-level trading around the relevant timestamps. None of those mechanisms can be separated using this NAV path alone.
paragraphs.zh: 被动去杠杆仍是一项待检验假设，需要融资敞口、保证金门槛和带时间的强制卖出记录。赎回压力则要结合资金流出与实际卖出的持仓检查。若研究ETF交易如何影响股票价格，还须核对申赎、篮子成分和相关时点的逐股交易。现有净值缺少这些输入，无法分开估计各机制的影响。

paragraphs.en: A useful next design would freeze historical stock eligibility and compare microcap groups with larger stocks on matched dates, while controlling for liquidity and the timing of interventions. It would reconcile shares and cash before estimating executable losses. Until those inputs are available, this investigation supports a descriptive stress episode with a verified policy chronology; causal attribution and tradable capacity remain open.
paragraphs.zh: 下一步可以先固定历史股票资格，在相同日期比较微盘组与较大市值股票，并控制流动性及政策发生时点。估计实际可实现的损失前，还需核对股份与现金账户。目前能够确认的是这条重建路径上的压力过程，以及已经核实的政策日期。因果归属与可交易容量仍待研究。

title.en: Connect the exit investigation
title.zh: 接入退出困难调查

paragraphs.en: The exit study develops a shared measurement checklist for this episode and the US quote pilot. Historical constituent lists, financing and flows remain missing here. The NAV path supports loss chronology; execution and causal mechanisms require additional inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 退出调查为本次事件与美股报价试验整理了共同的测量问题。本章仍缺历史成分名单、融资与资金流。净值路径支持损失时间线，执行和因果机制还需要更多输入。

paragraphs.en: In a retrospective diagnostic with a running peak starting on 29 December 2023, the first 20% drawdown crossing occurred on 29 January 2024. Five retained observation steps later, on 5 February, the NAV was another 16.53% lower. This is a labelled change in the reconstructed path; it supplies no executable exit price.
paragraphs.zh: 在从2023年12月29日起累计高点的回顾诊断中，净值于2024年1月29日首次触及20%回撤门槛。五个保留观测间隔后，即2月5日，净值又下降16.53%。这项结果描述重建路径的后续变化，实际可成交的退出价格仍需另行取得。

paragraphs.en: An exit trigger and its execution date should be recorded separately. A threshold calculated after the close cannot silently receive that same close as a guaranteed fill. Delays, trading restrictions and incomplete orders can all move the realized account away from the NAV-based sensitivity shown here.
paragraphs.zh: 退出触发与执行日期应分别记录。收盘后算出的门槛，不能悄悄取得同一收盘价的保证成交。延迟、交易限制和未完成订单，都可能让实际账户偏离这里按净值计算的敏感性。

title.en: What the new sources can establish
title.zh: 新增材料能说明什么

paragraphs.en: The literature notes below separate contemporaneous crowding analysis from order-classification estimates and studies of other periods. Their investor definitions and outcome measures must be reconciled before treating them as a shared explanation.
paragraphs.zh: 下方文献记录区分同期拥挤分析、订单分类估计和其他时期研究。把它们用于同一解释前，需要对齐投资者定义和结果指标。

paragraphs.en: The CSRC’s February 28 statement describes deleveraging and reports roughly 3% daily market turnover from DMA after the holiday reopening. That period does not measure pre-holiday liquidation pressure.
paragraphs.zh: 证监会2月28日说明提到降杠杆，并报告春节后开市以来 DMA 日均成交占全市场约3%。这段时期无法衡量节前平仓压力。

paragraphs.en: A testable next step compares pre-event size/activity groups around January 17–23 and January 29–February 7, with matched ordinary periods. These historical windows are retrospective; freeze new thresholds before testing another episode.
paragraphs.zh: 下一步可比较事件前形成的市值与活跃程度分组，观察1月17至23日和1月29日至2月7日，并加入匹配的普通时期。这些窗口按历史事件回顾选取，新阈值应在检验另一段时期前固定。

limitations.en: One retrospective 400-stock rule reconstruction; no independent market index, security-level holdings, leverage, flows or execution validation.
limitations.zh: 样本为单条回溯的400只股票规则重建，未引入独立市场指数、逐股持仓、杠杆和资金流，也未验证实际执行。

limitations.en: Official announcement dates establish chronology, not causal effects. Public web pages were read on 27 November 2026; no immutable webpage bytes are claimed.
limitations.zh: 官方公告日期用于核对事件顺序，政策的因果效果仍待检验。网页于2026年11月27日阅读，未声称保留了不可变的网页文件。

nextSteps.en: Acquire matched historical holdings, financing and flow evidence before testing competing mechanisms; reconcile the source account first.
nextSteps.zh: 先核对来源账户，再取得同日期的历史持仓、融资和资金流证据，检验不同机制。

opening.en: The retained reconstruction earns a positive return for 2024, but the route to that ending value includes a 37.94% drawdown and a recovery spanning 179 observation intervals. This investigation follows that route at its actual retained dates, then places verified policy announcements beside it.
opening.zh: 保留重建在2024年取得正收益，走向这个年末值的过程，却包含37.94%的回撤和跨179个观测间隔的恢复。本篇沿着实际保留日期追踪路径，再把已核实的政策公告放在旁边。

opening.en: The timeline can establish sequence at daily resolution. It cannot determine which investor sold a stock or how a different policy path would have changed prices. That distinction matters most near the trough, where a memorable narrative is easy to form after the outcome is visible.
opening.zh: 时间线可以在日频分辨率下明确先后，却不能确定哪类投资者卖出了股票，也不能给出另一条政策路径下的价格。谷底附近尤其需要保留这个区别，结果已知后，很容易形成一套令人印象深刻的解释。

title.en: When can a small stock be sold?
title.zh: 小股票在下跌时有多难卖出？

summary.en: Exit research needs quote prices and displayed quantities together. A reproducible pilot and a turnover scenario identify what the next experiment must measure.
summary.zh: 退出研究需要一起检查报价与展示数量。已有试验和换手情景明确了下一轮需要测量什么。

question.en: How do spreads, available bids and the decision to rebalance affect an attempted exit?
question.zh: 价差、可见买盘和调仓规则会怎样影响卖出？

conclusion.en: Top-of-book quotes can diagnose trading conditions. Realised exit costs still require an order policy, time-aligned observations and a reconciled holdings record.
conclusion.zh: 最优买卖报价可以诊断交易条件。实际卖出成本仍需结合订单规则、对齐时间的观测和可核对的持仓记录。

title.en: Observe both sides of an exit
title.zh: 一起看卖出的价格和数量

paragraphs.en: A narrow spread says little about how much can be sold at the bid. Track valid-time spread, displayed bid dollars and quote age separately. Changes in price and share quantity can both change the displayed amount.
paragraphs.zh: 价差较窄时，买一档仍可能只有很少金额。需要分别跟踪有效时间价差、买盘金额和报价年龄。价格和股数的变化都会改变展示金额。

paragraphs.en: The retained US inputs support NBBO and enhanced trades. A quote is an offer at a point in time. Hidden liquidity, queue position, cancellation and replenishment remain outside this diagnostic.
paragraphs.zh: 现有美股输入支持 NBBO 和增强逐笔成交。报价描述一个时点的挂单情况，隐藏流动性、排队位置、撤单和补单仍超出这项诊断。

title.en: Check the observation before explaining the event
title.zh: 先检查观测，再解释事件

paragraphs.en: The follow-up compares spreads over all valid time with spreads for quotes aged below 60 seconds. It records invalid time and reports unknown trade direction by security. This avoids pooling active ETF trades into an apparently representative small-stock statistic.
paragraphs.zh: 后续检查同时计算全部有效时间和报价年龄低于60秒的价差，保留无效时间，并逐证券报告未知成交方向。高活跃 ETF 的成交数量可能主导合并统计，需要单独检查。

paragraphs.en: Company announcements between the two periods are possible confounders. A few half-hour windows and a selected security do not identify a market-wide pressure effect.
paragraphs.zh: 两个时期之间的公司公告可能影响比较。几段半小时窗口和一只挑选出的证券，无法识别全市场压力的影响。

title.en: Replay an order against historical events
title.zh: 把订单放回历史事件中

paragraphs.en: An event-level experiment fixes a decision time, order size and arrival delay, then uses only the quote available by arrival. Buy orders cross to the offer and sell orders to the bid. Report the modeled quantity, remaining quantity and cost relative to the decision midpoint together. Displayed quantity is a model input, not a fill guarantee.
paragraphs.zh: 事件级实验先固定决策时间、订单数量和到达延迟，再使用到达时刻之前的报价。买入按卖一价、卖出按买一价模拟，同时报告模拟数量、剩余数量和相对决策中间价的成本。显示数量是模型输入，实际能否成交仍需验证。

paragraphs.en: The private prototype compares one immediate order with six equal target slices over five seconds. An unchanged quote does not reset available size. At the same price, only positive displayed-size increments replenish the modeled budget. A price change resets that budget as an explicit sensitivity assumption; aggregated NBBO cannot identify individual resting orders.
paragraphs.zh: 私有原型比较一次下单与五秒内六次目标切片。相同报价不会重置可用数量，同价时只有显示数量的正增加才补充模型预算。价格变化后重置预算属于明确的敏感性假设，汇总 NBBO 无法识别逐笔挂单身份。

paragraphs.en: A low cost on the modeled shares can coexist with a large remainder. Compare completion fraction before comparing costs. Independent scenarios do not share liquidity budgets. No simulated remainder is silently filled at the last quote, and trade prints do not prove that a hypothetical order could have accessed that liquidity.
paragraphs.zh: 已模拟部分成本很低时，仍可能剩下大部分订单。比较成本前先看完成比例。独立情景分别计算流动性预算，剩余订单不会自动按最后报价成交。观察到真实成交，也不能证明假想订单当时能够取得那部分流动性。

paragraphs.en: Validate on dates selected before inspecting their results. Preserve the expected security-date grid, missing quotes, stale quotes and corrected trades. Report the number of complete windows alongside each comparison; a missing event window is not a zero-cost observation.
paragraphs.zh: 验证日期应在查看结果前固定。保留预定证券日期网格，以及缺失报价、陈旧报价和更正成交。每项比较都列出完整窗口数量，缺失事件窗口不能填为零成本。

title.en: Keep explicit fees next to price shortfall
title.zh: 把费用和价格损失放在一起

paragraphs.en: Fee sensitivity can combine a per-share charge, a parent-order minimum and a charge proportional to modeled notional. Apply the minimum once per parent scenario only when quantity is modeled. Publish the assumed schedule with the result. A hypothetical schedule is not a broker quote or a regulatory tariff.
paragraphs.zh: 费用敏感性可以同时设置每股费用、母订单最低费用和按模拟成交金额计费。只有模拟数量大于零时才计最低费用，每个母订单情景计一次。结果旁列明假设费率，假设费率不能称作券商报价或监管费率。

paragraphs.en: Add explicit fees to price shortfall on the modeled quantity, and retain the unexecuted remainder. Routing, queue priority, deep liquidity and own market impact still require further data or explicit assumptions. These US experiments do not calibrate the China A-share NAV or the arithmetic annual hurdle in this article.
paragraphs.zh: 在已模拟数量上合并显性费用与价格损失，未完成部分继续保留。路由、排队、多档流动性和自身冲击仍需更多数据或明确假设。这些美股实验尚未校准中国 A 股净值，也没有校准文中的年度算术门槛。

title.en: Expand with a fixed selection rule
title.zh: 用固定规则扩样

paragraphs.en: The next candidate list uses a fixed historical feature date and crosses capitalization with trading activity. Selection is deterministic within each cell. Reference matching comes first, including missing and duplicate identities. A modern snapshot can still contain later revisions.
paragraphs.zh: 下一份候选名单固定历史特征日，按市值与交易活跃程度交叉分组，组内使用可重复的选取规则。先核对参考映射，记录缺失和重复身份。现存快照仍可能包含后来的修订。

title.en: Let holding rules change before claiming better returns
title.zh: 先观察持仓规则怎样改变名单

paragraphs.en: A buffer retains an existing holding while its size rank remains within a wider exit boundary. The private prototype compares target membership changes with and without that buffer. Initial funding is excluded. Price drift, unavailable sales and return differences need a separate portfolio ledger.
paragraphs.zh: 缓冲规则允许旧持仓在更宽的退出排名内继续保留。私有原型已经比较有无缓冲时的目标名单变化，并排除首次建仓。价格漂移、无法卖出的持仓及收益差异，需要另接组合账户。

paragraphs.en: The calculator in this article changes spread and replacement assumptions independently. Its fixed chart scale makes a lower arithmetic hurdle visible. It does not calibrate those assumptions to a particular stock or strategy.
paragraphs.zh: 文中计算器可以分别调整价差和替换比例。图表采用固定刻度，便于观察算术成本门槛的变化。这些假设尚未按某只股票或策略校准。

paragraphs.en: The arithmetic calculator below assumes a full spread per round trip and annualizes how often that cost repeats. Its inputs are hypothetical. Moving a slider shows the consequences of an assumption, while measuring a real portfolio cost requires observed orders, quantities and fees.
paragraphs.zh: 下方算术计算器假设每轮完整买卖承担一个完整价差，再按成本重复频率折算年度门槛。输入是假设值。拖动滑块展示假设会带来什么结果，测量真实组合成本仍需要订单、数量和费用记录。

title.en: Compare China A-shares with explicit limits
title.zh: 跨市场比较先对齐口径

paragraphs.en: The 2024 China A-share chapter supplies a dated reconstructed NAV and policy chronology. The US pilot supplies top-of-book diagnostics for selected securities. Compare questions and denominators first; neither dataset fills the other market’s missing holdings or order records.
paragraphs.zh: 2024年中国 A 股章节提供重建净值和政策时间线，美股试验提供选定证券的最优报价诊断。先比较研究问题与分母，两份数据各自缺少的持仓和订单记录仍需补齐。

paragraphs.en: A useful matched design forms size and activity groups before each episode, compares them on common dates and retains securities that subsequently leave the sample. Forced sales require financing or redemption evidence in addition to prices.
paragraphs.zh: 后续对照可以在事件前形成市值与活跃程度分组，比较相同日期，并保留随后退出样本的证券。被动卖出的解释还需要价格之外的融资或赎回证据。

title.en: Date financial information by its release
title.zh: 按披露时间使用财务信息

paragraphs.en: SEC APIs expose filings and XBRL facts. Preserve the filing identity, units and reporting period, then verify when the information became available. Restated values retrieved today may differ from those known at formation.
paragraphs.zh: SEC API 提供申报记录和 XBRL 财务事实。保存申报身份、单位和报告期，再核对信息何时可用。今天取得的重述值可能与形成组合时可见的数字不同。

paragraphs.en: Profitability, operating cash flow, debt and dilution are useful candidate classifications. Original statements, concept mapping and historical shares must be checked before assigning those labels.
paragraphs.zh: 盈利、经营现金流、负债与股本摊薄可以作为候选分类。贴上标签前，需要核对原报表、会计字段和历史股本。

title.en: Read the earlier account audit alongside execution scenarios
title.zh: 把早期账户审计与执行情景一起读

paragraphs.en: The earlier archive records a bounded account that passes explicit sell-size and cash checks. The newer US NBBO scenarios address a different market and a different question. Their costs cannot be subtracted from that account or the China A-share NAV without a shared holdings and execution contract.
paragraphs.zh: 早期归档记录了一段通过显式卖出数量与现金检查的有限账户。新的美股 NBBO 情景研究另一个市场和问题。没有共同持仓与执行约定时，不能把美股成本直接扣到该账户或中国 A 股净值上。

limitations.en: The private pilot uses a retrospective candidate list. Historical equity eligibility and original release-time availability remain unverified.
limitations.zh: 私有试验采用回顾性候选名单。历史股票资格和原始信息发布时间仍未认证。

limitations.en: No provider-derived security observations are republished here. The interactive calculator is a hypothetical scenario.
limitations.zh: 本页没有重新发布供应商逐证券观测。互动计算器使用假设情景。

nextSteps.en: Acquire finer time windows after historical identity checks, retain nonmatches, and test independent periods.
nextSteps.zh: 核对历史身份后采集更细时间窗口，保留未匹配记录，再检验独立时期。

nextSteps.en: Connect adjusted prices, corporate actions and filing-time fundamentals before estimating strategy returns.
nextSteps.zh: 接入复权价格、公司行动和按披露时间匹配的基本面，再估计策略收益。

opening.en: A sell decision is complete only when the position has actually left the account. A narrow quoted spread can make the visible part look cheap while most of the order remains unfinished. This investigation keeps price, quantity and time in the same discussion.
opening.zh: 卖出决策要到持仓实际离开账户时才算完成。很窄的报价价差，可能让可见的一小部分显得便宜，同时大部分订单仍未处理。本篇把价格、数量与时间放在一起讨论。

opening.en: The evidence comes in different resolutions. Cross-market traded-value aggregates describe activity, short US event windows support quote scenarios, and the retained A-share account reviews test specific bookkeeping rules. Reading their scopes together prevents a number from one layer being presented as the answer to another.
opening.zh: 现有证据的分辨率不同。跨市场成交额汇总描述活跃度，美股短事件窗口支持报价情景，保留的中国 A 股账户复查则检验具体核算规则。把范围放在一起读，可以避免用一层的数字代答另一层的问题。

title.en: The next research tests
title.zh: 下一轮研究检验

summary.en: Historical identity checks come first. Exit conditions and accounting determine which larger tests are ready.
summary.zh: 先核对历史身份。退出条件与组合记账决定后续检验能走到哪一步。

question.en: Which next experiment can materially change our conclusions?
question.zh: 下一项实验能改变哪些现有判断？

conclusion.en: Prioritise a reproducible historical cohort and stress-liquidity comparison before a broad return claim.
conclusion.zh: 优先完成可复现的历史名单和压力流动性对照，再扩大收益结论。

title.en: First, retain the stocks that disappear
title.zh: 先保留后来消失的股票

paragraphs.en: Historical eligibility is the first gate for the US study. The bounded private audit retains missing, inactive and ambiguous matches across explicit dates. Quote availability can change within a fixed candidate cohort.
paragraphs.zh: 美股研究先核对历史资格。有限范围的私有审计按日期保留未匹配、失效与歧义记录。固定候选名单中，报价可用性也会变化。

paragraphs.en: Next, reconcile listing identifiers, corporate actions and delisting treatment. Publish exclusions and the denominator before interpreting spread differences. The cohort is retrospective and is not certified as a historical common-stock universe.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来核对上市标识、公司行动和退市处理。在解释价差差异前，公开排除规则与分母。现有名单属于回顾性候选，尚未认证为历史普通股股票池。

paragraphs.en: Freeze the expected security-date grid before downloading quotes. An inactive listing, a missing identifier and an empty quote window should remain distinguishable outcomes. If only successful matches survive into the analysis, the sample can become easier to trade by construction.
paragraphs.zh: 下载报价前先冻结预定证券日期网格。失效上市、缺少标识和报价窗口为空，应保留为不同结果。若分析只留下成功匹配的观测，样本可能在构造过程中就变得更容易交易。

paragraphs.en: Preserve the identifier valid on each date and the source that links it to the issuer. Later ticker reuse or a reverse split can create an apparently continuous symbol with a different underlying identity. A reference date also does not prove when that field was first available to a researcher.
paragraphs.zh: 保存每个日期有效的标识，以及把它连到发行人的来源。代码重用或反向拆股，可能让连续的代码背后出现不同身份。参考日期也不能证明研究者最早何时能够取得该字段。

title.en: Then test the deterioration of exit conditions
title.zh: 再检验卖出条件怎样恶化

paragraphs.en: Form size/activity cells before each episode. Compare fresh-quote spreads and displayed bid dollars on common time windows, report missing time, and retain exits from the cohort. Use stock-level and date-level dependence when estimating uncertainty.
paragraphs.zh: 每个事件前按市值与活跃程度分组，在相同窗口比较新鲜报价价差和买盘金额，报告缺失时间，并保留退出名单的证券。估计不确定性时考虑同一股票及同一天观测的相关性。

paragraphs.en: A rise in spread accompanied by falling bid dollars is a diagnostic of worse displayed conditions. Forced-selling attribution also needs independent financing or redemption observations. NBBO supports the diagnostic but cannot reconstruct a full order book or guaranteed fills.
paragraphs.zh: 价差上升且买盘金额下降，可以诊断可见交易条件变差。归因于被动卖出还需要独立的融资或赎回观测。NBBO 支持这项诊断，无法还原完整订单簿或保证成交。

paragraphs.en: Coverage should be checked on wider windows before interpreting an empty short interval. The bounded audit can compare full-day activity, a half-hour interval and the selected seconds, then compare UTC conversion with the provided local clock. These checks narrow possible data errors without certifying an entire feed.
paragraphs.zh: 解释短窗口为空之前，应先检查较宽窗口的覆盖。有限审计可以并列全天活动、半小时区间和选定秒段，再比较 UTC 转换与来源提供的本地时钟。这些检查可以缩小数据错误范围，但没有认证整条行情源。

paragraphs.en: An order experiment should retain completed quantity and remainder before reporting a cost average. A later validation set must be declared before its outcomes are inspected, with the same order policy and missing-data treatment. Reusing nearby historical dates is a useful check, but it is not automatically an independent final test.
paragraphs.zh: 订单实验应先保留完成数量与余量，再报告成本均值。后续验证日期要在查看结果前确定，并沿用相同订单规则和缺失处理。使用附近历史日期可以做核查，但不会自动成为独立最终检验。

title.en: Distinguish small operating businesses
title.zh: 区分小公司的经营状况

paragraphs.en: Within matched size/activity groups, compare cash-generating firms with loss-making or heavily diluting firms. Preserve filing publication times and historical shares. A current financial snapshot cannot supply point-in-time classifications.
paragraphs.zh: 在匹配市值与活跃程度后，比较有经营现金流的公司与亏损或频繁摊薄股本的公司。保存财报公布时间和历史股数，当前财务快照无法直接提供当时可见的分类。

paragraphs.en: Accounting classifications need filing identities and release times. A report describing an earlier quarter can still have been published after portfolio formation. Preserve original filings and revisions rather than using today’s restated fields to label yesterday’s companies.
paragraphs.zh: 财务分类需要申报身份与公布时间。报表描述较早季度，也可能在组合形成后才发布。应保留原申报和修订，不能直接用今天的重述字段标记过去的公司。

title.en: Measure what a holding buffer actually changes
title.zh: 测量持仓缓冲实际改变了什么

paragraphs.en: Connect the rank-buffer prototype to a cash/share ledger. Compare realised turnover, delayed sales and net returns under the same cost assumptions. The existing membership-replacement result alone cannot establish a better strategy.
paragraphs.zh: 把排名缓冲原型接入现金与股数账户，在相同成本假设下比较实际换手、延迟卖出和净收益。已有名单替换结果尚不足以判断策略更好。

paragraphs.en: Minimum observation counts belong in the frozen rule. The archived 120-session example changes when the required count changes from 90 to 45, and the holdings can differ beyond the warm-up period. A later sensitivity run is valuable evidence about that dependence, while the original run identity remains a separate recovery task.
paragraphs.zh: 最低观测数量属于需要冻结的规则。归档120日例子会随90或45个最低观测而变化，持仓差异还会延续到预热期之后。后来的敏感性运行可以说明这项依赖，恢复原始运行身份仍是另一项任务。

paragraphs.en: Keep the original and repaired results next to each other, then explain what changed. Accepting a result should depend on its source and checks rather than whether its annual return is attractive. The same rule applies when a repair reduces an earlier estimate.
paragraphs.zh: 把原结果与修复结果并列，再说明改变了什么。接受一个结果，应依据来源和检查，而非年化收益是否吸引人。修复降低了原估计时，也应遵循同一标准。

title.en: Make cross-market comparisons after local validation
title.zh: 各市场验证后再做跨市场比较

paragraphs.en: Use within-market ranks, common trading-activity definitions and explicitly dated samples. Report China A-share price-limit and settlement constraints separately from US quote diagnostics. Prioritise reproducible episode comparisons before pooling returns across markets.
paragraphs.zh: 使用市场内排名和相同交易活跃度定义，明确样本日期。中国 A 股涨跌停及交收约束与美股报价诊断分别记录。先完成可复现的事件比较，再考虑跨市场汇总收益。

title.en: Give each result an acceptance condition
title.zh: 为每项结果写清接受条件

paragraphs.en: For a return-path diagnostic, complete source identity and consistent arithmetic may be enough. A cash-account result additionally needs share conservation and event treatment. An executable strategy claim needs a further comparison with actual market access and calibrated costs. Each stronger conclusion asks for additional evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 描述收益路径时，完整来源身份与一致计算可能已经足够。现金账户还需要股份守恒和事件处理。可执行策略则进一步需要市场访问与校准成本的对照。判断越强，所需证据也越多。

paragraphs.en: The evidence-status page keeps these stages visible across the project. A failed check should preserve its inputs and reason, so a later repair can be compared with the same setup. Research depth comes from closing a specific gap, not merely adding another attractive output.
paragraphs.zh: 证据状态页会把这些阶段在项目中持续显示。检查失败时，应保存输入和原因，让后来的修复能够与同一设定对照。研究要继续推进，需要解决具体缺口，单独增加一个表现好看的输出还不够。

limitations.en: This is an executable research agenda, not a completed causal study or a new strategy backtest. Provider-derived security observations remain private.
limitations.zh: 本章列出研究步骤，尚未完成因果研究或新策略回测。供应商逐证券观测继续保留在私有数据目录。

nextSteps.en: Finish historical identity reconciliation and register a fresh-quote stress comparison on a separate episode.
nextSteps.zh: 完成历史身份核对，在另一段事件上预先确定新鲜报价压力对照。

opening.en: The next study should be chosen by the uncertainty it can resolve. More securities or a longer price history can add observations without fixing the missing link between a trading rule and an account. The retained work now makes several of those links explicit enough to test in order.
opening.zh: 下一项研究，应根据它能解决哪项不确定性来选择。增加股票或延长价格历史，可能增加观测，却没有补上交易规则到账户之间的缺口。已有工作已经把其中一些连接写得足够明确，可以按顺序检验。

opening.en: This chapter sets out that order and the evidence each step must leave behind. It is a research protocol, not a new performance result. The window-rerun comparison later in the article provides a concrete example of how a seemingly minor input rule can change the accepted conclusion.
opening.zh: 本篇说明这个顺序，以及每一步需要留下什么证据。它是一份研究方案，没有新增业绩结果。后面的窗口复算对照提供了具体例子，一项看起来很小的输入规则，也可能改变能够接受的结论。

title.en: What remains after controlling for size and trading activity?
title.zh: 控制规模与交易活跃度后，还剩下什么？

summary.en: Comparable samples, microcap exclusions and window reruns change the interpretation of low-turnover results.
summary.zh: 可比样本、微盘剔除与窗口复算，会改变低换手结果的解释。

question.en: How much of the observed return difference survives a change in controls or portfolio rules?
question.zh: 改变控制变量和组合规则后，观察到的收益差还能保留多少？

conclusion.en: The archived evidence supports a retrospective association that depends on the sample and construction. It does not establish an independently investable low-turnover premium.
conclusion.zh: 归档证据支持依赖样本和构造方式的历史关联，低换手独立可投资的溢价仍未确立。

title.en: Compare the same object
title.zh: 先分清比较的对象

paragraphs.en: The original report contains a long-short cross-sectional spread, a long-only low-turnover candidate and a combined size/turnover portfolio. Their return numbers use different denominators and holding rules. A positive low-minus-high turnover spread can come from the weak high-turnover leg without producing the same gain in a long-only account.
paragraphs.zh: 旧报告同时讨论截面低减高换手收益差、纯多头低换手候选和小盘加低换手复合组合。收益数字对应不同的分母与持仓规则。低减高为正，可能来自高换手端较弱，不能直接换算成低换手多头账户的收益。

paragraphs.en: The 40-name monthly candidate with a 60-name retention buffer must also be distinguished from the 400-name smallest-cap NAV on the homepage. Their position counts, ranking rules and accounting assumptions are different.
paragraphs.zh: 月频40只目标、60只保留缓冲的候选，也需要与首页400只最小市值净值分开。两者持仓数量、排名规则和核算假设都不同。

title.en: What a matched control changes
title.zh: 共同样本怎样改变判断

paragraphs.en: In the retained eligible universe, the common-sample small-minus-large monthly gross return spread is about 1.47 percentage points. It falls to 0.43 within illiquidity groups and 0.35 within trading-activity groups. Both conditional intervals include zero. These comparisons show how the description changes under controls; they do not identify a causal liquidity effect.
paragraphs.zh: 在保留的合格股票池中，共同样本小减大月度毛收益差约为1.47个百分点。在非流动性组内为0.43，成交活跃度组内为0.35，两项条件区间均包含零。它们说明控制后描述发生了什么变化，不能据此识别流动性的因果作用。

paragraphs.en: Within size groups, the low-minus-high turnover spread is about 1.25 percentage points, with a reported 95% interval from 0.62 to 1.88. The comparison covers 136 formation dates from March 2015 through June 2026, with a final return endpoint in July 2026. The 24 exploratory estimates do not carry a simultaneous multiple-testing guarantee.
paragraphs.zh: 规模组内的低减高换手收益差约为1.25个百分点，报告的95%区间为0.62至1.88。对照覆盖2015年3月至2026年6月的136个形成日，最后收益终点为2026年7月。24项探索估计没有同时控制全部检验误差。

paragraphs.en: A separate corrected control study uses 86 common months from May 2019 through June 2026. Its sample is not interchangeable with this 136-date exercise or the older 133-formation decomposition. Read each comparison with its own universe and missing-return count.
paragraphs.zh: 另一项修正后的控制研究使用2019年5月至2026年6月的86个共同月份。它不能与这里的136期对照或更早的133次形成分解混用。每项比较都要保留自己的股票池和未来收益缺失数量。

title.en: Remove the smallest-cap tail
title.zh: 剔除最小市值尾部

paragraphs.en: The exclusion experiment removes 0%, 10%, 20% or 30% of eligible stocks by formation-date size rank, then rebuilds signals. These are fractions of the number of eligible names, not fractions of aggregate market capitalization. Re-ranking after exclusion changes the portfolio as well as its coverage.
paragraphs.zh: 剔除实验按形成日市值排名，移除合格股票数量的0%、10%、20%或30%，再重新计算信号。分母采用合格股票只数。重新排名会同时改变组合与覆盖范围。

paragraphs.en: With equal weighting and the buffer, the archived small-cap candidate falls from 5.24% to −2.17% annual return after removing the bottom 30%. The low-turnover candidate rises from 5.33% to 7.76%, while the combined candidate moves from 11.28% to 9.71%. The candidates respond differently; one exclusion rule cannot stand in for every strategy.
paragraphs.zh: 等权并保留缓冲时，归档小盘候选在剔除最小30%后，年化收益从5.24%降至−2.17%。低换手候选从5.33%升至7.76%，复合候选从11.28%变为9.71%。不同候选反应不同，不能用一条剔除规则概括所有策略。

title.en: Buffer and weighting matter together
title.zh: 缓冲与权重也会改变结果

paragraphs.en: Across the 24 archived paired configurations, the buffer lowers turnover in every pair, but annual return rises in only eight. Trading less changes costs and exposure at the same time. A lower turnover statistic alone does not establish a better net account.
paragraphs.zh: 归档的24组配对配置中，缓冲全部降低换手，但只有8组年化收益提高。少交易同时改变成本和敞口，单看换手下降还不能判断净账户更好。

paragraphs.en: The market-cap-weighted low-turnover candidate is negative at every tested exclusion fraction. The combined candidate remains positive under both tested weighting schemes. These are descriptive grid results already inspected by the researchers; the best cell is not an independently validated parameter choice.
paragraphs.zh: 市值加权低换手候选在全部已测试剔除比例下均为负，复合候选在两种权重下仍为正。这些是研究者已经查看过的参数对照结果，最好的单元格尚未成为独立验证后的参数选择。

title.en: A longer window did not reproduce the published ranking
title.zh: 更长窗口的排序没有完整复现

paragraphs.en: The published snapshot shows higher annual return as the turnover window grows from 20 to 120 sessions. Later runs reproduce the rounded 20- and 60-session metrics. The 120-session run with a 90-observation minimum produces 4.22%, below the archived 7.60%; reducing the minimum to 45 produces 6.26%.
paragraphs.zh: 原公开快照中，换手窗口从20日延长到120日，年化收益随之升高。后来运行复现了20日与60日的舍入指标。120日要求至少90个观测时，年化为4.22%，低于归档的7.60%，把门槛降至45个观测后为6.26%。

paragraphs.en: The observation threshold changes which stocks receive scores and can continue to change holdings after warm-up. The 45- and 90-observation versions still produce different holdings in later years. Original historical input bytes and the complete run receipt remain missing, so the discrepancy cannot be declared resolved.
paragraphs.zh: 观测门槛会改变哪些股票取得评分，预热结束后也可能继续改变持仓。45与90观测版本在后续年份仍出现持仓差异。历史原始输入文件和完整运行记录仍缺，差距尚不能宣布解决。

title.en: Frequency changes the portfolio
title.zh: 调仓频率怎样改变组合

paragraphs.en: The fixed report retains all sixteen combinations of four turnover definitions and four rebalance frequencies. At the 60-session mean, the biweekly candidate reports 19.00% annual return and 3.25 times annual turnover. The monthly candidate reports 7.73% and 6.77 times. Scheduling fewer rebalance dates can still produce more turnover because the dates select different targets and weights.
paragraphs.zh: 固定版旧稿保留了四种换手定义与四种调仓频率的16组组合。采用60日均值时，双周候选年化收益19.00%，年换手3.25倍。月频候选对应7.73%与6.77倍。调仓日期更少，累计换手仍可能更高，因为不同日期会选出不同的目标和权重。

paragraphs.en: Changing the definition also changes the result. Under biweekly rebalancing, the 20-session mean reports 17.07% annual return and the 120-session mean 21.18%, with drawdowns of −60.16% and −60.48%. Both have deep historical losses. The table lets readers compare return and drawdown without selecting only the highest-return cell.
paragraphs.zh: 定义也会改变结果。双周调仓下，20日均值年化收益17.07%，120日均值21.18%，最大回撤分别为−60.16%与−60.48%。两种候选都经历了深度亏损。切换下方指标，可以同时检查收益与回撤，查看高收益配置付出了多大代价。

paragraphs.en: The development and later periods must remain visible. The monthly 20-session candidate moves from 3.11% in development to 25.75% later. These dates have already been inspected, so selecting a definition from this grid creates another parameter choice to test prospectively. The separate window rerun above uses another construction and cannot be spliced into this table.
paragraphs.zh: 开发段和后段也应并列。月频20日候选在开发段年化3.11%，后段25.75%。研究者已经看过这些日期，按表格挑出的参数需要另找未参与选择的样本检验。上方窗口复算采用另一套构造，数字应分别保留。

title.en: What would strengthen the inference?
title.zh: 什么证据能让判断更强

paragraphs.en: Freeze the universe, timestamp rules and minimum-observation policy before evaluating new dates. Keep low- and high-turnover legs alongside a long-only account, use matched formation dates for controls, and retain missing future returns instead of silently removing their stocks.
paragraphs.zh: 在检查新日期前冻结股票池、时间规则和最低观测门槛。保留低换手端与高换手端，并列纯多头账户，控制比较使用相同形成日，未来收益缺失的股票也留在分母中。

paragraphs.en: Only after shares, cash, corporate actions and execution assumptions reconcile can a lower trading frequency be translated into portfolio cost. A difference in target membership is an intermediate diagnostic.
paragraphs.zh: 股份、现金、公司行动和执行假设对账后，才能把较低调仓频率转译为组合成本。目标成员变化目前只是中间诊断。

limitations.en: The chapter reorganizes archived public evidence; it does not rerun or certify the historical strategies.
limitations.zh: 本章整理已公开归档证据，没有重跑或认证历史策略。

limitations.en: Samples and accounting differ across panels. Gross monthly spreads, annual simulated returns and executable returns are different quantities.
limitations.zh: 各面板样本和核算不同。月度毛收益差、年度模拟收益与可成交收益不能混用。

nextSteps.en: Recover the original 120-session run identity and test frozen rules on new observations.
nextSteps.zh: 恢复120日历史运行身份，并用新观测检验冻结规则。

nextSteps.en: See INV-012 for the common-date archived exposure diagnostic and the staged style/cost research requirements.
nextSteps.zh: 共同日期归档暴露诊断，以及分阶段风格／成本研究要求，见INV-012。

title.en: How a target list becomes a reconciled account
title.zh: 目标名单怎样变成可对账的账户？

summary.en: The report records both rejected replays and a later bounded account that passes explicit share and cash checks.
summary.zh: 旧报告保留重放被拒绝的记录，也记录了后来通过显式股份与现金检查的有限区间账户。

question.en: Which checks close an accounting failure, and what remains before historical performance is credible?
question.zh: 哪些检查能解决核算失败，历史业绩可信还需要哪些证据？

conclusion.en: A 21-session constructed replay passes its independent accounting checks. Full-history strategy readiness and real execution remain unestablished.
conclusion.zh: 一段21个交易日的构造重放通过了独立核算检查，完整历史策略可用性和真实执行仍未确立。

title.en: A target is not the inventory
title.zh: 目标与实际库存分别保存

paragraphs.en: The historical work first reconstructed frozen targets, then attempted to replay them from cash. A target weight specifies what the strategy wants to own. Suspensions, missing quotes and trade-size rules determine what the constructed account can actually acquire. Replacing holdings with target weights at each rebalance skips those constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 历史工作先重建冻结目标，再尝试从现金重放。目标权重描述策略想持有什么，停牌、缺失报价和交易单位规则会影响构造账户实际取得什么。每次调仓直接用目标权重替换持仓，会跳过这些约束。

paragraphs.en: The same distinction matters at corporate-action record dates. A stock appearing in a target file does not establish that the account held it on the entitlement date. The report retains unknown inventory and prior failed checks instead of assigning the entitlement automatically.
paragraphs.zh: 公司行动登记日也有同样区别。股票出现在目标文件中，不能证明账户在权益登记日实际持有。报告保留未知库存和先前未通过的检查，没有自动分配权益。

title.en: Capital changes cash and fills
title.zh: 资金如何改变现金与成交

paragraphs.en: The archived capital ladder runs the combined candidate at seven account sizes under a 5% participation assumption. At CNY100,000, annual return is 5.28%, reported fill rate 13.82% and mean cash 38.25%. At CNY1 million, the figures are 11.85%, 43.89% and 2.54%. A comparison of returns alone hides this large difference in how much capital the simulated accounts put to work.
paragraphs.zh: 归档资金梯度在5%参与率假设下，模拟复合候选的七档账户。10万元账户年化收益5.28%，报告成交率13.82%，平均现金38.25%。100万元账户对应11.85%、43.89%与2.54%。只比较收益，会漏掉两档模拟账户实际投入股票的资金比例差异。

paragraphs.en: At CNY50 million the recorded annual return reaches 15.07%, with a −51.70% drawdown and 6.18% mean cash. The simulator has not calibrated market impact. Higher return at a larger capital setting therefore remains a feature of this recorded simulation. Estimating capacity requires matched target dates and a decomposition of unfilled orders, cash exposure and impact.
paragraphs.zh: 5,000万元档记录年化收益15.07%，最大回撤−51.70%，平均现金6.18%。模拟器尚未校准市场冲击。资金设定更大时收益更高，目前只能作为这次模拟的结果保存。估算容量还要固定目标日期，把未成交订单和现金敞口分别核对，再测量冲击。

title.en: Read the two share ledgers separately
title.zh: 两个份额账本怎样比较

paragraphs.en: The retained monthly continuous-share ledger reports 15.06% annual return, 12.63% mean cash and 50.56% fills. The biweekly ledger reports 14.13%, 21.12% and 75.37%. Higher reported fills accompany more cash and a lower annual return in this pair, so fills alone cannot rank the accounts.
paragraphs.zh: 保留的月频连续份额账本记录年化收益15.06%，平均现金12.63%，成交率50.56%。双周账本对应14.13%、21.12%与75.37%。这组记录里，成交率更高的账户也留有更多现金，年化收益更低。评价账户需要一起核对这些数字。

paragraphs.en: The source lists 139 versus 296 formations, 138 versus 295 weight targets and 137 versus 37 engine replay periods. These counts do not establish matched intervals. Simulated impact is zero and the currency basis of the reported delay cost remains unresolved. The two ledgers retain separate identities until their dates and accounting can be reconciled.
paragraphs.zh: 来源分别列出139与296次形成、138与295次权重目标，所属引擎重放期数却为137与37。现有计数还不能证明区间匹配。模拟冲击为零，报告延迟成本的币种口径仍待确认。核对日期和核算方式前，这两个账本应分别保存。

title.en: What the bounded replay actually covers
title.zh: 有限区间核对了什么

paragraphs.en: The later review covers 21 sessions and two frozen formations with 40 targets each, spanning 46 distinct target stocks. It scans 2,230 source rows, includes one in-window action and excludes one pre-entry action. The constructed record contains 79 fills, comprising 73 buys and six sells.
paragraphs.zh: 后续复查覆盖21个交易日、两次冻结形成，每次40只目标，共46只不同目标股票。检查扫描2,230行来源记录，纳入一项区间内事件，排除一项入场前事件。构造成交记录共有79笔，其中73笔买入、6笔卖出。

paragraphs.en: The review matches 57 non-code inputs and four captured artifacts to the earlier attempt. Calendar, target definitions and source identities match, so the improvement can be assessed within the same bounded setup. These fills are constructed account records rather than observed broker executions.
paragraphs.zh: 复查把57项非代码输入和4份捕获制品与先前尝试核对一致。日历、目标定义和来源身份匹配，因此可以在同一有限设定下判断检查发生了什么变化。这些成交属于构造账户记录，未观察到券商真实执行。

title.en: Make the sell rule explicit
title.zh: 明确卖出数量规则

paragraphs.en: The passing replay explicitly enables a 100-share sell unit independently of the buy-side lot setting. Partial sales use that unit, while a complete exit can liquidate integer odd-lot shares. The retained default continues to allow continuous shares; the bounded result cannot be generalized to that default.
paragraphs.zh: 通过核验的重放显式启用100股卖出单位，与买入端交易单位独立设置。部分卖出按该单位处理，完整清仓允许卖出整数零股。保留的默认模式仍可使用连续份额，有限区间结果不能推广到默认行为。

paragraphs.en: The rule rejects inputs explicitly declared as adjusted prices and rejects the capacity/weight-ledger path. Raw-share execution and adjusted-price return ratios answer different questions. A simulator rule is not a certification of every exchange and board’s order-entry rules.
paragraphs.zh: 这项规则拒绝明确声明为复权价格的输入，也拒绝容量或权重账本路径。原始股份执行与复权价格收益比回答的问题不同，模拟器规则还没有认证所有交易所和板块的申报要求。

title.en: Keep small accounting errors visible
title.zh: 保留微小核算残差

paragraphs.en: Independent checks retain maximum absolute errors of approximately 1.455×10⁻¹⁰ yuan for cash, 1.164×10⁻¹⁰ for marked holdings and 5.684×10⁻¹⁴ for fees, below the original 10⁻⁷-yuan tolerance. The errors remain in the record rather than being rounded away to pass a check.
paragraphs.zh: 独立检查保留现金的最大绝对误差约1.455×10⁻¹⁰元，持仓计价约1.164×10⁻¹⁰元，费用约5.684×10⁻¹⁴元，均低于原有10⁻⁷元容差。核验记录保留了这些残差。

paragraphs.en: A reconciled identity only shows that this account is internally consistent under its stated inputs. It does not prove that historical information arrived on time, that all events were captured or that a large order could execute at the assumed price.
paragraphs.zh: 核算恒等式对上，只能说明这份账户在注明输入下内部一致。历史信息能否及时取得、事件是否完整，以及大订单能否按假定价格执行，还需要各自验证。

title.en: Keep missing endpoints unresolved
title.zh: 保留缺失端点的未知状态

paragraphs.en: The retained ST comparisons include entries that precede delisting and entries that are already suspended. Last traded price, a later transfer arrangement and cash settlement are separate evidence. An untradeable original entry cannot be repaired merely by finding a later terminal value.
